audience.builderHint: Use a different link for each place you share it. Insights then shows which one brings visitors.
audience.tagHint: Most visits show as Direct? Share <link>tagged links</link> to see which channel works.
audience.referralHint: Shared links carry the sharer's personal code, so you see whose shares bring visitors and donations.

insights.accuracyNote: Visitors and donation steps come from privacy-friendly analytics without cookies. People who block trackers are not counted, so read these as a guide rather than exact figures. Amounts raised and donation totals come from our records; donations by direct debit or bank transfer count once the payment arrives, so they can show up a few days later.
